name: poet’s circuit
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The poet's circuit is an Irish mythological motif. Once a bard finished training, he traveled Ireland to meet other poets. He traded tales and verses and held spoken contests. While on a circuit the fair maiden Liadan met Cuirithir, her chosen lover. He asked her to stop, and she refused to break her road.

okr.objective: Record the poet's circuit and Liadan's tale.
key_results: calls the circuit a line of trained bards
places Liadan's meeting on the road
ends with her refusal to stop
